title: 공군미사일방어사령부령 / queue:ARTICLE:6:0:00006:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 6 (Emergency Military Measures, etc.)
(1) Where urgent measures are necessary for military reasons or in response to a disaster, the Commander may temporarily command and supervise units that are within the area of jurisdiction determined by the Commander of the Air Force Operations Command under Article 2 but are neither subordinate nor attached to the Command.
(2) Where the Commander has commanded and supervised units that are neither subordinate nor attached to the Command pursuant to paragraph (1), the Commander shall report the circumstances without delay to the Commander of the Air Force Operations Command and notify the commander of the superior unit to which the relevant unit belongs.
